exposure: parental psychiatric diagnoses before offspring birth
maternal diagnoses of schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorders
paternal diagnoses of schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorders
any psychiatric diagnosis (for mothers, fathers, or both parents)
outcome: age of onset of offspring MD
cohort: The study included 37,677 offspring diagnosed with major depression (cases) and 145,068 matched controls without major depression, identified from Finnish national registers.
finding: Parental psychiatric disorders, including those diagnosed before offspring birth, were associated with an increased risk of offspring major depression across various age groups, with stronger associations observed for maternal schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorders and depression, paternal schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorders and conduct disorders, and for MD onset at younger ages when both parents were affected.
